subject.title: Add persistent cron job execution history with filtering

question: Which remaining cron-history capabilities should core own beyond the existing durable SQLite store and Control UI filters?
rationale: Timestamp and CLI filters are a bounded extension, while raw follow/export, aggregate reporting, retention-days configuration, and manual database maintenance introduce distinct security, compatibility, and operator-policy commitments.

options.title: Add bounded filters
options.body: Add after and before filters plus CLI parity for existing status and query filters, with bounded summary queries and no raw follow or database-maintenance commands.

options.title: Build full audit tooling
options.body: Implement follow/export, reliability aggregates, and configurable retention with explicit authorization, redaction, and upgrade contracts.

options.title: Keep current scope
options.body: Treat SQLite persistence, Control UI filtering, JSON output, and automatic pruning as sufficient and decline the remaining surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add bounded filters
recommendation.body: Add after and before filters plus CLI parity for existing status and query filters, with bounded summary queries and no raw follow or database-maintenance commands.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite cron migration and earlier scheduler and history provenance make steipete the strongest available owner for deciding the permanent core boundary.
